goal: Deliver the first end-to-end provider-neutral context pipeline from normalized repository graph to budgeted files and Python symbols, with deterministic evidence and measured token savings.

execution_waves.exit_condition: Normalized graph contract, fallback, policy boundaries, and tests pass.
File-level context output remains compatible and budgeted with durable reasons and hashes.
Python symbol/snippet retrieval works with safe fallback and deterministic tests.
Token savings and relevant-surface recall are measured and documented.

selection_rationale: This order creates a vertical slice while resolving graph-contract uncertainty before compiler and symbol work. It uses 10 of 12 capacity units and leaves slack for integration findings.
